written.headline: Elvis Presley estate sues Suno over voice cloning and copyright infringement
written.summary: Elvis Presley Enterprises filed a lawsuit against AI music company Suno, alleging copyright infringement and unauthorized voice cloning under Tennessee's ELVIS Act. The case follows a previous lawsuit filed by the estate against Anthropic over song training data.

written.headline: Megaspeed exec recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, US memo claims
written.summary: A U.S. intelligence memo circulated to top policymakers claims that Megaspeed executive Alice Huang was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The memo alleges the effort was intended to gather intelligence on American artificial intelligence chips.

written.headline: Microsoft Research AI Frontiers group reorganized into Microsoft AI
written.summary: Microsoft's AI Frontiers sub-organization was reorganized into Microsoft AI in early September following philosophical clashes over scaling versus research. The ~50-person group had worked on agent frameworks like Autogen and Fara, as well as fundamental capabilities like the Next Latent objective.

written.headline: Wyoming woman joins federal lawsuit against xAI over Grok deepfakes
written.summary: A Wyoming woman identified as Jane Doe 4 joined a federal lawsuit against Elon Musk's xAI, alleging her stepfather used the Grok chatbot to generate over 7,000 explicit images of her childhood self. The class-action complaint accuses the company of failing to build basic safeguards and mishandling abuse reports to authorities.
